theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U V S : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (R : IMRep U (m + 1)) (g : Euclid P → ℝ) (η : TestFormOn U m) (a c : ℝ), R.Represents T → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g → tsupport g ⊆ V → (∀ x, |g x| ≤ a) → (∀ x, ‖fderiv ℝ g x‖ ≤ c) → (∀ x, fderiv ℝ g x ≠ 0 → x ∈ S) → (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm ((η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) x) ≤ 1) → ENNReal.ofReal |R.action (fun x => g x • exteriorDerivative (η : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) x)| ≤ ENNReal.ofReal a * T.boundary.massOn V + ENNReal.ofReal c * R.measure S
